recent.text: Really strong response from the Rockets after briefly losing the lead early in the 3rd. From that point, they've outscored the Clips, 30-15. KD and Tari Eason combined for 18 of those 30 points. Feelsl ike Rockets are finally starting to impose their will.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: Tari Eason hits a floater as the buzzer sounds and the #Rockets end the third quarter up 85-75 over the Clippers. Houston was down 5 early in the frame before a 10-0 run pushed it back in front. KD and Garland have 20p each. Şengün and Thompson with 16p apiece.
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Mentioned that the guards needed to be more active after a slow start. FVV just forced back-to-back turnovers. Amen Thompson has 7 pts and 2 assts in the quarter. The Rockets are starting to pick their energy up as this game goes.
recent.author: Will Guillory
